payload.title: Document monitoring on the Papyrus marketing site
payload.description:
Standing rule: every shipped capability is documented on the Papyrus marketing site.

```gherkin
Feature: Monitoring is documented on the marketing site
  Scenario: A visitor learns what the Monitoring page shows
    When they read the Papyrus marketing site
    Then they find what the Monitoring page shows (feeds, runs, collected queue, relevance and delivery, usage vs ceilings) and who may see it
```

Follow-up to the Monitoring page story; do after the page is live.
